descriptionChirho: A proper noun designating the city of Beth-shean (also spelled Beth-shan, Beit-Shean), located in the territory of Manasseh west of the Jordan River in the Jezreel Valley. The name means 'place of quiet' or 'house of rest.' All clusters refer to the identical geographic location; the variation is purely orthographic and prepositional (bare citation, with beth 'in', with min 'from'). Referenced in Joshua, Judges, 1 Samuel, 1 Kings, and 1 Chronicles. All multilingual glosses consistently transliterate the same city name.
